breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and periodic). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the Dirichlet condition. The generated specification correctly states to 'Apply zero Dirichlet boundary conditions on all boundaries', completely omitting the incorrect periodic condition, thus resolving the inconsistency.
